how: Extracted by scripts/gate_shards.py::parse_failures from the six shard logs of the 2026-09-09 six-shard run at 0ffe68a14 (1181 files). That run predates the committed wrapper and is NOT of record for a pass/fail verdict, but its logs are a faithful capture.

At the new base the two sets are IDENTICAL: master introduced no failure this baseline lacks, and after removing the one entry master FIXED (see removed_because_master_fixed_it, attributed to 4fef130d9) no baseline entry is absent at the base. Nothing here is the hub's. ⛔ If either of the two load-sensitive names recorded under prior_base appears as NEW in a future run, re-run it ALONE before treating it as a regression.
